name: Example small-site stack
use_case: Running a small public site with its own analytics and shared notes.
selection_rationale: Both members are listed, both run on the same provider, and neither duplicates the other's job.

members.role: Shared notes for the people running it.

overlaps.note: Both want their own PostgreSQL database; the provider bills each separately.

integration_note: Each member was verified on its own. Nothing was checked about the two running together.
